## Change

Describe the problem and the resulting behavior. Link the relevant issue, if any.

## Validation

List the checks run and their results. For documentation-only changes, note the
document and link checks instead of running app tests.

## Safety and privacy

Describe any effect on prompt matching, tab targeting, remembered approvals, or
stored data. Write "No change" when this does not apply.

## Checklist

- [ ] I followed [CONTRIBUTING.md](https://github.com/panlam85/approval-assistant/blob/main/CONTRIBUTING.md).
- [ ] I added or updated tests for changed matching or automation behavior, if applicable.
- [ ] I ran unit tests and built the app for code changes, or explained any blockers.
- [ ] I updated documentation for user-visible behavior, if applicable.
- [ ] Examples, screenshots, and logs contain no private Terminal content or credentials.
